items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You and Illinois sure were huge contributors to the phenomenon. I can remember Illinois Jacquet, Flip Phillips, and Willie Smith at one time or another. Nat Cole . . . [INTERVIEWEE] Finally Lester Young . . .

ctx.x: Abbey Lincoln. A lot of people. A lot of people. I have the article here. I'll show it to you. It's interesting. It can explain in much more detail about what April the 6th at Carnegie Hall is all about than I can ever do. We saved it just for that purpose, 'cause I’ve tried a couple of times to explain to people and they say, "I don’t know what you're talking about." [Then I say,] "Here, read this." [And then they say,] "Oh! Now we know what you mean."
